lines.text: "title": "docs(agents): stop agents rediscovering how to drive the host window, and fix four repo traps",

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.summary: Eval: add parts cases; accept a page-object part in cigster-99
lines.text:
"body": "A retro of the last 10 agent sessions (ubuntu-pc and the MacBook Pro) found that agents find code fine; the time goes on stale or missing know-how. In most sessions an agent worked out from scratch how to drive and record the host window, because the manual-testing skill points at tmux and `computerUse`, which those sessions didn't have. Docker smoke runs left root-owned SDK output that broke the next `pnpm build`. Adding a demo section silently left `ROUNDS` and the bench keys stale. Refreshing a PR review deleted its screenshots. Device lessons (one FTP connection per upload, Vita3K won't render headless on ubuntu-pc) lived only in one machine's agent memory.

- `scripts/gui-drive.sh` (`key`, `click`, `shot`, `rect`) drives the window on Linux X11 or Xvfb (xdotool and ffmpeg, with the down/up events GLFW needs) and on macOS (a Swift CGEvent helper). The manual-testing skill now covers headless runs, logging to a file, and recording on both platforms, plus corrected Host Control steps (`--port` on `link`, `timeout` on Windows, the npm companion on a second computer).
- `scripts/smoke-docker.sh` hands back `js/packages/*/dist` and `js/examples/*/.vitadeck` as well, from an EXIT trap so it also happens when a step fails.
- `tests/demo_sections.h` holds `DEMO_SECTION_COUNT`: `ROUNDS` uses it and `smoke_harness` static-asserts `PAGES` against it. A comment above the demo's `SECTIONS` lists everything that changes with a section, including the bench key scripts.
- A republish to the same Pages dest keeps `evidence/`.
- The stb_ds implementation compiles once in `vitadeck_core` (`src/core/stb_ds.c`) instead of in `main.c` and 13 harnesses.
- Footgun 6 now covers the follow-up listing or size check after an upload, and the emulator skill covers `active-package.txt`, the rewritten `config.yml`, and running headless.
- `AGENTS.md` Setup covers corepack picking the wrong pnpm from the repo root and building raylib 5.5 from source where the distro lacks it (Ubuntu 26.04). `docs/releasing.md` gains a tested recipe for trying the SDK and companion as an author before they reach npm.
- The review rules ("Hit every surface", plus ADR, manifest and glossary checks) move into `CODING_STANDARDS.md`, so review delegates get a real standards file; `AGENTS.md` keeps a pointer.

Checks: `agent-check.sh fast` (also after the docs commits) and `smoke` passed, plus the host build and all 18 non-smoke CTests. `gui-drive.sh` was driven against the host under Xvfb (F1, Down, click, screenshots); the macOS helper compiles and runs on the MacBook Pro, but keys and clicks there are untested because they need a window and Accessibility. The Pages change was tested against a local bare remote.

Review: https://matemolnar8.github.io/vitadeck/pr/150/

Created with Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code.
",
